cases.name: renewables-specialist
cases.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Administrator with experience in the renewal energy sector to join our team! In this vital role, you will be the backbone of daily office operations, displaying great communication skills and ensuring efficient administrative processes. Your proactive approach and attention to detail will help foster a productive workplace where everyone can thrive. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to develop your administrative skills while supporting a vibrant team dedicated to excellence.

Duties

Manage customer contracts, including customer liaison and handling phone inquiries with professional etiquette
Coordinate scheduling for meetings, appointments, and company events to optimize team productivity
Perform data entry tasks accurately using Microsoft Office applications, Google Workspace, and bespoke software packages as needed
Maintain organized filing systems, both digital and physical, ensuring easy retrieval of documents and records
Support accounting processes by processing invoices, expense reports, and other financial documentation
Assist with inventory management and procurement of office supplies to ensure operational readiness
Handle correspondence via email and phone, ensuring timely responses and clear communication across departments

Experience

Proven office experience with a strong understanding of administrative procedures
Proficiency in computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive), and QuickBooks
Demonstrated clerical experience with data entry, filing, and document management
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment
Strong phone etiquette and communication skills to interact professionally with clients, vendors, and team members
Experience with compliance documentation including MCS records, Building regulations, insurance backed guarantees, electrical certificates and heat loss designs.
Familiarity with basic accounting or bookkeeping is a plus but not required

Pay: £35,000.00-£40,000.00 per year

Benefits:

Casual dress

Work Location: In person
